independent_execution.scope: Both frozen-random seed-7 representation controls on the exact 512-row TRAIN diagnostic subset
independent_execution.result: Reconstructed all 4,965 TRAIN windows, hash-loaded both final random-control checkpoints, recomputed both diagnostic dictionaries and obtained exact equality with the saved report.
independent_execution.same_support: Random and corresponding learned representations use identical row IDs and cutoff interval IDs.

interpretation: The random encoder is already highly concentrated at effective rank 6.37 of 128 on this fixed dataset/architecture subset, so raw rank cannot be interpreted against a full-rank ideal alone.

Both learned seed-7 targets reduce effective rank further than their identical random initialization control: EMA to 3.97 and shared-SIGReg to 3.53. This is a severe dimensional-concentration and collapse signal.
EMA additionally shows a pathological predictor/target scale mismatch: RMS ratio 25.24 and variance ratio about 10,026, versus 1.79 and 0.073 for the random control.
Shared-SIGReg avoids the EMA scale mismatch and has substantial per-dimension variance, but its lower effective rank still prevents a representation-quality success claim.
Downstream validation metrics and hybrid heads must be reported separately; a favorable forecast cannot erase this representation diagnostic.
excluded_scope: Final evaluation or JEPA representation-success claim
